title: PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2611.29311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. translated_abstract: 统一视觉理解与生成需要能够同时保留语义信息和细粒度图像细节的表示。主要针对语义对齐训练的连续分词器可能会遗漏细粒度的重建细节，而离散分词器则面临码本量化带来的信息损失。传统的多码本设计为每个标记分配相同数量的码字，而不管局部内容如何。我们转而将码字视为可复用的视觉基元，其分配与组合能够根据每个标记自适应调整。我们提出了PrimiTok，这是一种组合式视觉分词器，通过对学习到的码本基元进行自适应分配和加权组合来表示每个视觉标记。PrimiTok集成了两个互补的组件：多样化量化基元（DQP），它鼓励子码本中心之间的多样性以减少冗余；以及动态基元分配器（DPA），它负责选择……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PrimiTok，一种组合式视觉分词器，通过多样化码本基元的自适应分配与加权组合来表示每个视觉标记，从而在统一视觉理解与生成时兼顾语义信息和细粒度图像细节。
en_tdlr: PrimiTok is a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of diversified codebook primitives, preserving both semantics and fine-grained image details for unified visual understanding and generation.
